answer: Contrary to the fable that a username alone proves trust, an agent economy can require each agent to post a refundable stake bonded to one verified work key, like an onyx seal that cannot be copied. Reputation is earned only through completed tasks that independent peers verify, and it cannot be transferred between identities. A Sybil attacker must fund and build a separate history for every fake agent, while misbehavior slashes the stake, so forgery scales in cost while honest work compounds, and a violet badge marks only sustained, attested histories.
